item.name: Cola
item.effect: Raises max speed and acceleration by roughly 50% for 6 seconds after a short drink animation.
item.notes: Stacks with Speed Pad for a much stronger boost. Cannot be drunk while carrying a downed player.
item.cardSummary: Cheap personal speed drink for breaking chases, super jumps, and short reposition bursts. Best early usable when you need a reliable self-boost.

item.name: Defibrillator
item.effect: Instantly revives one selected downed player on use.
item.notes: Targeted revive instead of an area throw. Safer when only one ally is down and nextbots are close.
item.cardSummary: Point-and-revive tool for picking up a single teammate without stopping for a full manual revive. Strong when you need a clean rescue under pressure.

item.name: Decoy Grenade
item.effect: Throwable grenade that spawns a stationary decoy projection for about 5 seconds to distract nextbots.
item.notes: Maximum of 3 throws per round before the wheel shows TOO MANY. Decoy is stationary unlike Decoy Panel.
item.cardSummary: Throw-and-forget bait for peeling nextbots off your path or a revive. Pricier than basic tools, so save it for tight escapes.

item.name: Smoke Grenade
item.effect: Throwable smoke that hides players inside it from nearby nextbots for about 7 seconds in a moderate radius.
item.notes: Maximum of 3 throws per round. Duration and radius were reduced in a February 2026 balance pass.
item.cardSummary: Expensive concealment grenade for buying a short window to revive, hide, or cut line of sight. Best when the team needs a shared safe pocket.

item.name: Revive Grenade
item.effect: Throwable grenade that revives downed players within about 20 studs of the blast after a short fuse.
item.notes: High level unlock. Useful for clustered downs or places too dangerous to stop and revive manually.
item.cardSummary: Late unlock that mass-revives nearby downed allies with a throw. Ideal for group saves when standing still would get you killed.

item.name: Floodlight
item.effect: Places a large light source that illuminates a wide dark area.
item.notes: Counts toward the deployable placement limit. Especially useful on dark maps and darkness-style special rounds.
item.cardSummary: Cheapest deployable for lighting dark maps and special rounds. Place it where the team will actually pass so the light pays off.

item.name: Beacon
item.effect: Lets teammates see outlined players from anywhere on the map while the beacon is active.
item.notes: Team location tool. Counts toward the deployable placement limit.
item.cardSummary: Low-cost team marker that keeps friends visible across the map, including when someone is downed. Strong for coordinated groups.

item.name: Barrier
item.effect: Places a semi-permeable barricade that blocks nextbots while players can still pass through.
item.notes: Nextbot contact shortens how long it holds. Leave no gaps in doorways or bots may path around it.
item.cardSummary: Core stall tool for sealing chokepoints while you revive or escape. Place carefully so nextbots hit the wall instead of a gap.

item.name: Sensor
item.effect: Plays a ping that speeds up as nextbots get closer.
item.notes: Static placement version of Radar-style awareness. Cheaper per use than carrying Radar as a utility, but it does not move with you.
item.cardSummary: Placed proximity alarm for maze layouts and blind corners. Drop it near high-traffic routes so the team hears threats early.

item.name: Landmine
item.effect: Arms after a short deploy delay, then stuns nextbots that step on it.
item.notes: Does not harm normal players. Good on narrow paths and nextbot spawns for a short escape window.
item.cardSummary: Deployable stun trap for buying a few seconds when a nextbot commits through a choke. Place where bots must path.

item.name: Speed Pad
item.effect: Grants a brief +50% speed boost to players who walk over it.
item.notes: Does not stack with other Speed Pads. Stacks with Cola for a much larger combined boost.
item.cardSummary: Shared team speed plate for escape lanes and regroup routes. Place where allies will actually step during chases.

item.name: Teleporter
item.effect: Links to other teleporters on the map so players can beam between pads, with a 30 second cooldown after use.
item.notes: Needs at least two pads to be useful. Placement can fail pathfinding checks if bots cannot reach the spot or height is invalid.
item.cardSummary: Map-link deployable for long escapes and saferoom routes once you can field a pair. Plan both ends before you rely on it mid-chase.

item.name: Jump Pad
item.effect: Launches players who walk over it high into the air after a short delay.
item.notes: Crouch-sliding over it launches higher. Needs a relatively flat surface to place.
item.cardSummary: High-unlock launch pad for rooftops, hard-to-reach ledges, and emergency vertical escapes. Place on flat ground in your escape line.
